column1: # rainwarrior (Brad Smith) SNES test ROMs — FNV-1a framebuffer golden hashes (60 frames).
# The ROMs live in the gitignored tests/roms/external/rainwarrior/ tier (no explicit upstream
# license — usable locally, NOT redistributable, so only these DERIVED hashes are committed, per
# docs/adr/0003). The gate (crates/rustysnes-test-harness/tests/rainwarrior_golden.rs) self-skips
# when the ROM dir is absent, so CI (which lacks the ROMs) is unaffected; a local developer downloads
# them from https://github.com/bbbradsmith/SNES_stuff.
# Per-ROM input is fixed in the gate's config table (so the frame is deterministic):
#   twoship / elasticity : no input (hi-res / high-colour demos)
#   ctrltest*            : PAD_CONTRACT held on both ports ($9050 / $60A0, AccuracySNES Group F style)
#                          — exercises the $4016/$4017 manual + $4218-$421F auto-read display path
#   mset                 : a Mouse connected on port 2 and driven (dx=5,dy=-3,left) — exercises the
#                          32-bit mouse report read path (confirmed to change the display vs no-mouse)
# hi-res pair cross-validated vs MesenCE (twoship 26/26 colors exact; elasticity +2 MesenCE-brightness
# colors) — see the gate module doc. The ctrltest/mset hashes are regression baselines; the controller
# read path they exercise is independently cross-validated by AccuracySNES Group F (Mesen2 + snes9x).
# (multest_mul16 / multest_div16 are self-scoring and gated separately — no framebuffer golden.)
# name
twoship
elasticity
ctrltest
ctrltest_auto
